narrative.recommendations_md:
Each recommendation follows the structure: [ROOT CAUSE] with E-IDs → [SOLUTION] mapped to a Zennify offering from the 12-solution catalog → [EXPECTED OUTCOMES] table with qualitative metrics → [STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT] to entity objectives → [TECH VALIDATION] confirming technology not already deployed → [COUNTER-ARGUMENTS] for honest discussion. Per Rule R6, no investment amounts, ROI projections, or fixed-date timelines are included.
Tag legend: [ZENNIFY] = Zennify-scoped consulting engagement; [CLIENT] = independent client-led action (out of Zennify scope).
narrative.roadmap_md: The transformation roadmap is structured in four sequential waves anchored to dependency chains documented in §6 connected links. Per Rule R6, all phases are milestone-anchored, not date-anchored. Each wave unlocks downstream activations — the sequencing matters because the cap-chain matters. Maturity targets per phase are directional, not contractual; specific outcome metrics are defined per recommendation in §9.
